verdict.rationale: Fastmail documents a programmatic connection that an agent could use: the JMAP API, with a session object at /.well-known/jmap, OAuth 2.0 or Bearer API tokens, and batched methodCalls that "query, fetch, and send" in one request. That covers reading and sending mail for a self-built agent. However, nothing in the evidence shows a ready-made connection for Claude or ChatGPT, so those agents would need custom integration work. Drafting and triage (moving or labelling mail) through the API are only implied, not documented. Missing for 10: official MCP server or first-party Claude/ChatGPT connector, explicit API docs for drafts and triage actions, hands-on or independent evidence of agents running end to end.
